description: Execute SQL queries against the orchestration's knowledge database

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: SQL query to execute against the knowledge database

inputs.name: knowledge_base
inputs.description: The knowledge base to query, from a Knowledge Base node. If omitted, falls back to the flow's default knowledge base.

inputs.name: params
inputs.description: Parameters for parameterized queries (prevents SQL injection)

inputs.name: operation
inputs.description: Type of SQL operation (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE)

outputs.name: rowCount
outputs.description: Number of rows affected or returned

outputs.name: truncated
outputs.description: True when the returned data was capped (>1000 rows) — add a LIMIT to the query for the full set

outputs.name: operation
outputs.description: The SQL operation that was executed
